_comment: 2x H100 80GB: accelerate launch --config_file configs/accelerate_multi_gpu.yaml --num_processes 2 train.py ... gradient_accumulation_steps is the single-GPU value (4 -> 2 per GPU on 2 GPUs), so global batch = 4 x 2 x 2 = 16 and LR 1e-4 as in train_p1_vietnamese_scale3.json; unlike that recipe, AdamW uses weight_decay 0.1 and betas (0.9, 0.95) (Higgs-style), so results are not directly comparable. Gradient checkpointing off: ~17 MB/token activations were measured with eager attention up to 69 tokens; linear extrapolation to the longest scale3 sample (322 tokens) gives ~5.5 GiB/sample, so 4/GPU is ~29 GiB. flash_attention_2/sdpa (attn_implementation auto) use less, so this is conservative. per_device 8 + gradient_accumulation_steps 2 (-> 1 per GPU) is faster but should first be checked with a 1-step worst-case batch on the H100.
